## 维护者速读
- 是什么：ui ADR-0057 第 A5 修订：哪些打开方式开新会话、哪些回到原会话，build 例外，抽屉页头。
- 影响：C4 照这张表实现。
- 要你做什么：批准这个受管 PR（排在 #37819 之后）。

## What A5 says
Open-type table:

| How the drawer opens | Result |
|---|---|
| Header / top bar 「问 AI」, ⌘⇧I, Home 「Ask AI」, **and the last close was user-initiated** (×, button again, shortcut) | **new conversation** (`forceNew`) |
| Last close was the mobile auto-collapse after tapping an answer link (#37556) | the same conversation |
| A plan or write awaiting approval (the bus records its conversation id) | **that** conversation |
| `open()` with a target, legacy `/ai/:agent/:id`, share links, history, favourites | the named conversation |
| Page refresh, legacy-URL "expand on mount" | not an open; state kept |
| Studio canvas `requestOpen()` | unchanged |
| build threads, targets with `packageId` (`app.defaultAgent:'build'` can still land on build) | not covered; returns to the same conversation |
| narrow ↔ full screen | not an open; conversation unchanged |

- New conversations use `forceNew` only, never `resumeMode:'fresh'` (it treats "zero messages on the server" as empty, and a turn is persisted only when it ends, so a generating conversation would be reused).
- Drawer header: left = conversation title (「新会话」 before the first send; first-message summary when title generation is off); right = ☆ (from C8), ＋ new conversation, history (clock icon button), ⋯, ×. The mobile sheet header gets the same row.

## Acceptance
- A5 merged after A4; it names the A3 sentence it supersedes.
